title: h-guard outbound rule
description: One outbound rule of a rule pack (rule pack schema 1), one rule per YAML file. Outbound rules scan prompts and tool output; a hit counts toward the rule's category, whose action and question are set in the config (outbound.categories). Regular expressions are compiled and examples run by "h-guard config validate --rules <dir>", which is authoritative.

id.description: Rule id: lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or digit. Shares the id space with action rules. explicitly_requested and blast_radius are reserved.

enabled.description: Whether the rule is active; the config can override it (rules.<id>.enabled).

category.description: Category the hits count toward (e.g. credentials, private_key, pii): lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.

match.description: Local detection: regular expressions or a built-in detector, not both.

examples.description: Example texts checked by "h-guard config validate": hit must match, miss must not.
